fullPassage: Each beech tree grows in a particular location and soil conditions can vary greatly in just a few yards. The soil can have a great deal of water or almost no water. It can be full of nutrients or not. Accordingly, each tree grows more quickly or more slowly and produces more or less sugar, and thus you would expect every tree to be photosynthesizing at a different rate. However, the rate is the same. Whether they are thick or thin, all the trees of the same species are using light to produce the same amount of sugar per leaf. Some trees have plenty of sugar and some have less, but the trees equalize this difference between them by transferring sugar. This is taking place underground through the roots. Whoever has an abundance of sugar hands some over; whoever is running short gets help. Their network acts as a system to make sure that no trees fall too far behind.

questions.passage: Each beech tree grows in a particular location and soil conditions can (A)[match / vary] greatly in just a few yards. The soil can have a great deal of water or almost no water. It can be full of nutrients or not. Accordingly, each tree grows more quickly or more slowly and produces more or less sugar, and thus you would expect every tree to be photosynthesizing at a (B)[similar / different] rate. However, the rate is the same. Whether they are thick or thin, all the trees of the same species are using light to produce the same amount of sugar per leaf. Some trees have plenty of sugar and some have less, but the trees equalize this difference between them by (C)[transferring / blocking] sugar. This is taking place underground through the roots. Whoever has an abundance of sugar hands some over; whoever is running short gets help. Their network acts as a system to make sure that no trees fall too far behind.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) vary=다르다, (B) different=다른, (C) transferring=옮기는(이동). 토양은 크게 다를 수 있고, 나무마다 다른 속도로 광합성할 것 같지만, 나무들은 당분을 옮겨 차이를 없앤다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① match - different - transferring: (A) match(일치하다)는 '토양 조건이 크게 다를 수 있다'는 문맥에 반대
✅ ② vary - different - transferring: 토양이 다르고(vary), 다른 속도(different)를 예상하며, 당분을 옮겨(transferring) 차이를 없앤다. 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ vary - similar - transferring: (B) similar(비슷한)는 '다른 속도로 광합성할 것으로 예상된다'는 문맥에 반대
❌ ④ vary - different - blocking: (C) blocking(막는)은 '당분을 옮겨 나눈다'는 문맥에 반대
det.tip: 토양은 다양하다(vary) → 다른(different) 속도 예상 → 당분을 옮겨(transferring) 나눔

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) nutrients=영양분, (B) plenty=풍부함, (C) abundance=풍부함. 토양은 영양분이 가득할 수 있고, 어떤 나무는 당분이 풍부하며, 당분이 풍부한 나무가 나눠 준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① nutrients - plenty - abundance: 토양은 영양분(nutrients)이 가득, 어떤 나무는 당분이 풍부(plenty), 풍부함(abundance)을 가진 나무가 나눠 줌. 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② toxins - plenty - abundance: (A) toxins(독소)는 '영양분이 가득하다'는 긍정 문맥에 반대
❌ ③ nutrients - little - abundance: (B) little(거의 없는)은 'plenty of sugar(당분이 풍부한)'와 반대
❌ ④ nutrients - plenty - shortage: (C) shortage(부족)는 '당분이 풍부한(abundance) 나무가 나눠 준다'는 문맥에 반대
det.tip: 영양분(nutrients) 가득 → 당분이 풍부한(plenty) 나무 → 풍부함(abundance)을 나눠 줌

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) equalize=균등하게 하다, (B) underground=땅속의, (C) network=연결망. 나무들은 차이를 균등하게 하고, 이는 땅속에서 일어나며, 그들의 연결망이 시스템 역할을 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① widen - underground - network: (A) widen(넓히다)은 '차이를 없앤다(균등하게 한다)'는 문맥에 반대
❌ ② equalize - aboveground - network: (B) aboveground(지상의)는 '뿌리를 통해 땅속에서 일어난다'는 문맥에 반대
✅ ③ equalize - underground - network: 차이를 균등하게(equalize), 땅속(underground)에서, 연결망(network)이 작동. 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ equalize - underground - barrier: (C) barrier(장벽)는 '뒤처지는 나무가 없게 돕는 시스템'이라는 협력 문맥에 반대
det.tip: 차이를 균등하게(equalize) → 땅속(underground) 뿌리 → 연결망(network)이 도움

✅ ② shortage: 부족. plenty의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ③ supply: 공급(량). plenty와 유의어에 가까움
❌ ④ variety: 다양성. 의미축이 다른 단어(소거법 방지용)
det.tip: plenty(풍부함) ↔ shortage(부족). excess·supply는 '많음' 쪽이라 반대가 아니에요.

questions.passage:
(A) In a dry summer, whoever is running <u>short</u> of sugar gets help from stronger trees.
(B) We only had a <u>short</u> break between the two long classes.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 short의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A): 부족한(running short of=~이 부족한) - (B): 짧은(a short break=짧은 휴식)
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A): 부족한 - (B): 짧은: (A)의 be running short of ~는 '~이 부족하다', (B)의 a short break는 '짧은 휴식' ←정답
❌ ② (A): 짧은 - (B): 부족한: 두 의미가 반대로 배치됨
❌ ③ (A): 부족한 - (B): 부족한: (B)는 '짧은'
❌ ④ (A): 짧은 - (B): 짧은: (A)는 '부족한'
det.tip: running short of sugar=당분이 부족한 / a short break=짧은 휴식

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a large system made up of many parts or people that are connected to one another"

det.korean: network: 서로 연결된 많은 부분이나 사람으로 이루어진 큰 체계(연결망)
det.analysis:
❌ ① nutrient: 영양분. 정의와 무관
❌ ② abundance: 풍부함. 정의와 무관
✅ ③ network: 연결망. 서로 연결된 여러 부분으로 이루어진 체계라는 정의에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ location: 장소. 정의와 무관
det.tip: network = 서로 연결된 부분들로 이루어진 체계(연결망)

questions.passage: Accordingly, each tree grows more quickly or more slowly and produces more or less sugar, and thus you would expect every tree to be __________ (photosynthesize) at a different rate. However, the rate is the same.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 현재분사형. photosynthesize → photosynthesizing
det.analysis: 동사 photosynthesize(광합성하다)를 현재분사 photosynthesizing으로 바꿉니다. 'expect + 목적어 + to be + -ing(~하고 있을 것으로 예상하다)' 구조에서 to be 뒤에는 진행을 나타내는 -ing 형태가 와야 해요.
det.tip: to be + -ing = ~하고 있는. photosynthesize → photosynthesizing

questions.passage: Some trees have plenty of sugar and some have less, but the trees equalize this difference between them by __________ (transfer) sugar. This is taking place underground through the roots.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 동명사형. transfer → transferring
det.analysis: 동사 transfer(옮기다)를 동명사 transferring으로 바꿉니다. 전치사 by(~함으로써) 뒤에는 명사 역할을 하는 동명사가 와야 하므로 transferring이 됩니다. transfer는 자음+모음+자음(-fer)으로 끝나고 강세가 뒤에 있어 r을 하나 더 붙여 transferring이 돼요.
det.tip: by + 동명사(-ing) = ~함으로써. transfer → transferring (r 하나 더!)

questions.passage: Each beech tree grows in a particular location and soil conditions can vary greatly in just a few yards. The soil can have a great deal of water or almost no water. It can be full of nutrients or not. Accordingly, each tree grows more quickly or more slowly and produces __________, and thus you would expect every tree to be photosynthesizing at a different rate. However, the rate is the same. Whether they are thick or thin, all the trees of the same species are using light to produce the same amount of sugar per leaf. Some trees have plenty of sugar and some have less, but the trees equalize this difference between them by transferring sugar. This is taking place underground through the roots. Whoever has an abundance of sugar hands some over; whoever is running short gets help. Their network acts as a system to make sure that no trees fall too far behind.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 각 나무는 더 빠르거나 느리게 자라며 더 많거나 적은 당분(more or less sugar)을 만든다
det.analysis:
❌ ① exactly equal sugar: 정확히 같은 양의 당분. 바로 앞 'more quickly or more slowly(더 빠르거나 느리게)'의 대비 구조와 맞지 않음
✅ ② more or less sugar: 더 많거나 적은 당분. 앞의 '더 빠르거나 느리게(more ~ or more ~)' 구조와 짝을 이루어 자연스러움 ←정답
❌ ③ no sugar at all: 당분이 전혀 없는. 이어지는 '다른 속도로 광합성'과 모순
❌ ④ only bitter sap: 쓴 수액만. 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: grows more quickly or more slowly and produces ______ → more or less sugar (대구 구조!)

questions.passage: Each beech tree grows in a particular location and soil conditions can vary greatly in just a few yards. The soil can have a great deal of water or almost no water. It can be full of nutrients or not. Accordingly, each tree grows more quickly or more slowly and produces more or less sugar, and thus you would expect every tree to be photosynthesizing at a different rate. However, the rate is the same. Whether they are thick or thin, all the trees of the same species are using light to produce the same amount of sugar per leaf. Some trees have plenty of sugar and some have less, but the trees equalize this difference between them by transferring sugar. This is taking place underground through the roots. Whoever has an abundance of sugar hands some over; whoever is running short gets help. Their network acts as a system to make sure that no trees __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 연결망은 어떤 나무도 너무 뒤처지지 않도록(fall too far behind) 보장한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① grow much taller: 훨씬 크게 자란다. 협력으로 균형을 맞춘다는 문맥과 무관
❌ ② lose their leaves: 잎을 잃는다. 본문 근거 없음
❌ ③ block the sunlight: 햇빛을 막는다. 협력 문맥과 반대
✅ ④ fall too far behind: 너무 뒤처지다. 당분을 나눠 어떤 나무도 뒤처지지 않게 한다는 결론에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: make sure that no trees ______ → fall too far behind (뒤처지다)
